title: Law to require high sodium warnings at chain restaurants
summary: This bill would require chain restaurants with 15 or more locations to post a red-and-white triangle warning icon on menus and food tags for items containing 1,800 milligrams or more of sodium per serving, along with a factual warning statement about high sodium intake. It also requires the Department of Health to issue implementing rules within 6 months and conduct public outreach to affected restaurants. Violations would carry a civil penalty of $200 to $500.
